interaction: Flip the whole site between a twinkling night sky and a sunny day with one switch, then click, tap or Tab through six real star buttons — Gacrux, Acrux, Imai, Mimosa, Alpha Centauri and Hadar, plotted from real coordinates — to draw the Southern Cross and the Pointers; the chart then zooms out to construct the South Celestial Pole and drop a line to south, with each step explained, before a date-aware booking form gives a sample price.
notes: Star positions use a simplified projection for an upright Cross; the horizon in the finding-south diagram is not to scale.
